meta.title: Transparency portal · Regeneration Credit
meta.description: Check on the blockchain the certificates, offsets, inspections and impact of Regeneration Credit users.

footer.note: All data on this page is read directly from the Regeneration Credit contracts on the Sintrop blockchain.

verify.readNow: Data read from the Sintrop blockchain at {time}.

map.unavailable: The map is not available right now.
map.label: Map of the regeneration areas

inspection.title: Inspection #{id}
inspection.invalidatedNote: Invalidated by the community on {date}; it doesn't count toward the impact.

notRegistered.titleRole: This address is not a registered {role}
notRegistered.title: This address is not a registered user
notRegistered.body: No Regeneration Credit profile is linked to this wallet. If you got here from a QR code, the certificate may not be authentic.

supporter.metaDescription: {name} offset {amount} in the Regeneration Credit, funding {carbon} of carbon in regeneration. Check it on the blockchain.
supporter.certificateSubtitle: The same numbers as the certificate issued by the app.
supporter.shareTitle: {name}'s contribution certificate in the Regeneration Credit
supporter.impactNote: The impact per RC is recalculated by the RegenerationCreditImpact contract with every new inspection, so these numbers may differ from a certificate generated on another date. The total of RC offset never changes.
supporter.offsetsSubtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No offsets} one {# offset recorded on the blockchain} other {# offsets recorded on the blockchain}}
supporter.noOffsets: No offsets made through the Supporter contract.
supporter.directBurns: Besides the offsets listed, {amount} were certified by burning tokens directly.
supporter.commitmentsSubtitle: Items the Supporter has publicly committed to reduce.
supporter.commissions: Received {amount} in commissions for referring {count, plural, one {# offset} other {# offsets}} by invited Supporters.

regenerator.metaDescription: {name} regenerates {area} with {inspections} inspections recorded in the Regeneration Credit. Check it on the blockchain.
regenerator.certificateSubtitle: The same numbers as the certificate issued by the app.
regenerator.shareTitle: {name}'s regeneration certificate in the Regeneration Credit
regenerator.averageHint: average of {count, plural, one {# inspection} other {# inspections}}
regenerator.scoreNote: Each inspection counts trees and species in the area and produces a score from the Regeneration Index. The regeneration score adds up the inspections; the tree and species averages use the whole history, like the certificate.
regenerator.areaSubtitle: {area} bounded by {points} points recorded on the blockchain.
regenerator.inspectionsSubtitle: {realized} completed out of {total} in the history. Reports and photos are stored on IPFS.
regenerator.receivedSubtitle: Rewards paid to this wallet by the Regenerators pool.
regenerator.delationsSubtitle: Any user can file a report; the community votes on invalidation.

about.inspector: Inspectors visit the areas, count trees and species and record the results with photos and a report.
about.researcher: Researchers publish research, evaluation methods and the impact calculator items.
about.developer: Developers publish reports of their work on the protocol's code and apps.
about.contributor: Contributors publish reports of contributions such as education, translation, design and documentation.
about.activist: Activists invite Regenerators and Inspectors to the community.

role.levelHint: sets the share of the pool rewards
role.inspectionsSubtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No inspections} one {# inspection} other {# inspections}}
role.invitedSubtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No invitations sent} one {# person invited} other {# people invited}}

search.label: Search by name or wallet
search.placeholder: Regenerator or Supporter name, or wallet address
search.notFound: No user found with that name.

howTo.title: How to verify a certificate
howTo.subtitle: Regeneration Credit certificates can be checked by anyone, without relying on whoever issued them.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: The certificate's QR code opens the Supporter's or Regenerator's public page on this portal.

compare.title: Compare the numbers
compare.body: The "Certificate" block shows the same numbers as the certificate, read from the blockchain right now.

history.title: Check the history
history.body: Every offset and every inspection is listed with its date, amounts and documents.

explorer.title: Go to the source
explorer.body: The "transaction" and "Check on the explorer" links open the original record on the Sintrop blockchain.

howTo.more: Want to understand the protocol rules?

home.title: Regeneration of Nature that anyone can verify
home.subtitle: See who regenerates, who supports it and the impact of each certificate, straight from the blockchain.
home.impactSubtitle: Totals calculated by the RegenerationCreditImpact contract from the inspections.
home.mapSubtitle: {count} areas recorded. Click an area to see the Regenerator.

directory.regeneratorsSubtitle: People and communities regenerating areas and receiving Regeneration Credit inspections.
directory.regeneratorMeta: {score} pts · {inspections, plural, one {# inspection} other {# inspections}}
directory.supportersSubtitle: People and companies offsetting their impact by funding regeneration.
directory.offsets: {count, plural, =0 {no offsets} one {# offset} other {# offsets}}
directory.communitySubtitle: The other roles that keep the protocol running.
